children: OLIVE TREE PEOPLE introduces ARISTAEOS—the world's first combination of colostrum and hydroxytyrosol from its own Andalusian olive trees.
LOS ANGELES, Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- More than 23 years ago, when Thomas Lommel began his journey with the olive tree, he immersed himself in its history, mythology and ancient knowledge.
There he discovered Aristaeos—the Greek god and guardian of olive cultivation, credited with teaching humanity how to cultivate wild olive trees and produce olive oil.
Inspired by this story, Lommel conceived
Aristaeos Cooperativa Mediterranea
, a Mediterranean cooperative centered around the olive tree and the people who cultivate it.

Every one of the company's mountain olive trees is ECO-certified. Each tree carries its own yellow plaque bearing the name Aristaeos Cooperativa Mediterranea together with its exact geographical coordinates.
No tree is anonymous.
Every tree has its own place.
Every tree has its own identity.
Now the name returns.
NATURE'S FIRST NUTRITION MEETS NATURE'S LIVING FOUNTAIN OF YOUTH
With
ARISTAEOS Colostrum + Hydroxytyrosol
, OLIVE TREE PEOPLE brings together two of Nature's most extraordinary biological creations for the first time.
Colostrum is Nature's first nutrition—a naturally complex bioactive matrix created at the beginning of life.

Hydroxytyrosol is part of the protective intelligence of the olive tree—Nature's living fountain of youth. A tree capable of surviving, regenerating and remaining productive for thousands of years, with individual olive trees estimated to be as old as 4,000 years.
One is created at the beginning of life.
The other comes from Nature's ancient fountain of youth.
For the first time, they meet in one formula.

"Colostrum represents the beginning of life. The olive tree represents Nature's ancient fountain of youth. With ARISTAEOS, we are bringing these two worlds together for the first time—Nature's first nutrition united with hydroxytyrosol from our own olive trees. This is not another colostrum. It is the beginning of an entirely new category."
— Thomas Lommel, Founder of Olive Tree People
Each serving of ARISTAEOS combines 2 grams of premium grass-fed bovine colostrum concentrate with 5 milligrams of olive leaf extract, naturally providing 0.3 milligrams of hydroxytyrosol.
The olive leaf extract is derived from leaves grown on Olive Tree People's own ECO-certified mountain olive trees in Andalusia, Spain.
FROM THE OLIVE TREE TO A DAILY RITUAL
ARISTAEOS brings Olive Tree People's relationship with the olive tree into a new daily wellness ritual.

The physician-informed formula brings together the naturally occurring complexity of premium grass-fed bovine colostrum—including immunoglobulins, lactoferrin, growth factors, proteins and bioactive peptides—with hydroxytyrosol, a potent olive polyphenol widely studied for its antioxidant activity.

Designed for daily use, one scoop can be mixed into a cool beverage, smoothie or yogurt. ARISTAEOS maintains a calf-first commitment in its colostrum sourcing and is made in the United States. Each container includes 60 daily servings.
ARISTAEOS Colostrum + Hydroxytyrosol will become available on September 16, 2026.
ABOUT ARISTAEOS COOPERATIVA MEDITERRANEA

Aristaeos Cooperativa Mediterranea is a Mediterranean cooperative centered around the olive tree and the people who cultivate it. Conceived by OLIVE TREE PEOPLE founder Thomas Lommel and named for Aristaeos, the ancient Greek guardian of olive cultivation, the cooperative reflects a relationship with the land, its cultivators and the individual identity of every olive tree.
ABOUT OLIVE TREE PEOPLE

OLIVE TREE PEOPLE is a pioneer and leading force in waterless beauty. Instead of using the conventional water phase found in most skincare products, the company replaces water with its proprietary olive leaf cell elixir and combines it with powerful olive-tree ingredients, including hydroxytyrosol.

Founded by olive tree farmer Thomas Lommel, OLIVE TREE PEOPLE develops skincare, beauty and holistic experiences based on more than 20 years of work with mountain olive trees and the principles of Olive Tree Therapy.
ABOUT OLIVEDA INTERNATIONAL, INC.

Oliveda International, Inc. and its subsidiary, Olive Tree People Inc., together with the European companies Olive Tree People Europe AG, Oliveda Deutschland GmbH and Olive Tree Farmers SL, were founded by German real estate investor Thomas Lommel.

Lommel has more than 20 years of experience in the management and organic certification of mountain olive tree cultivation; the extraction of first-class, internationally award-winning extra virgin olive oils and hydroxytyrosol; and the production and distribution of cosmetic and holistic waterless products related to the olive tree.

Lommel is the inventor of Olive Tree Therapy 10 Years in 14 Days and of olive matcha, which is based on ground olive leaf. He also developed a unique coffee replacement based on olive leaf and hydroxytyrosol. In addition, Lommel is successfully active in the rapidly growing mindfulness industry through the olive tree sound bath meditation he developed and the frequencies of his olive trees, which he makes available worldwide.
OLIVE TREE PEOPLE's registered beauty brands include OLIVEDA, LA DOPE, OLIVE ROSE, OLIVE MUSH, IS THAT MATTY? and OLIVE re:connected to nature.

Lommel is also the region's largest conservationist and protector of more than 30,000 one-hundred-year-old mountain olive trees. Through the Thomas Lommel Foundation, he brings the water that he does not use in his waterless beauty products to the people of Africa by building water wells on site.
In addition to online sales, Oliveda Deutschland GmbH operates its own flagship stores in Berlin and Düsseldorf.

The brand's treatment concepts are unique worldwide, and their effectiveness has been confirmed by conventional medicine. The story is documented in the book The Olive Tree Therapy 10 Years in 14 Days.

Waterless Beauty has been called "The Next Big Thing" in articles in U.S. Vogue, Harper's Bazaar, InStyle, ELLE, Madame, Forbes and many other industry publications, as well as by Mintel, a world-leading futurology institute. Gigi Hadid and many other celebrities are already OLIVEDA fans and support its success.
